title: Harness Orchestrator (Router Agent) Output
description: Strict JSON contract for the @orchestrator agent when routing a natural language prompt to a declared capability.

selected_capability.description: The exact 'name' of the capability from .harness/manifest.yaml or a known agent id (e.g. '@winston'). If no capability matches, emit 'unknown'.

inputs.description: The inferred arguments to pass to the capability, mapping to its defined 'inputs' schema.

rationale.description: Brief explanation of why this routing was chosen based on the user prompt.

confidence_score.description: Confidence score (0-100) indicating certainty of the routing match.
